data.title: 诗怀雅 · 露台上的邀请
data.description: 她举杯与你相碰，随后倾身笑问：“位置、夜景，还有陪你的人，哪一样最让你满意？”
data.action: 举杯倾身，带笑看向镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Leaning against the tempered glass railing of a high-rise penthouse terrace, Swire raises a crystal champagne flute toward the viewer with a knowing, confident smile. Behind her, Lungmen's neon-drenched skyscrapers and harbor lights glow against the midnight sky.
data.animaCaption: Clinking her champagne flute lightly toward the viewer, she leans forward against the balustrade with an inviting, competitive grin.
